dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), developed by NACL for Japan Medical Association. Uses GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL conventions with Unix-style file paths (/var/tmp/), COPY statements with .INC extensions, and no COMP-3 usage.

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical receipt (shinryo hoshuu) processing system - specifically hospital admission (nyuuin) medical act input subsystem for the JMA ORCA standard receipt software
purpose.summary: This program is the hospital admission medical act input component (ORCGK02NYU) of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles data entry and processing for inpatient medical procedures, managing screen SPA areas, parameter files, and calling numerous subprograms for medical fee calculation and validation. It is part of a large production system used by Japanese medical institutions for insurance billing.

notable_features: 565 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
Japanese EUC/Shift-JIS encoded comments (latin-1 decoded as garbled)
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
Extensive flag and index working storage areas
Version history spanning 2002-2009 with many revisions
verdict.notes: Comments are encoded in Japanese (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) and decoded as latin-1, resulting in garbled display. The file is 426KB with 10338 lines, indicating a large production program. The ORCA system is a well-known open-source Japanese medical receipt software. Source truncated at 16000 chars but structural indicators confirm full COBOL program.
